title: The thread embodiment of holographic quantum entanglement
topic: Worldline formalism / holographic transport / MERA-AdS connections
summary: Develops the 'entanglement thread' formalism for holographic duality — thread-like objects that visualize holographic quantum entanglement. Tensor network models are deformed into quantum circuit form with flow-conserving features. The threads form a preset ensemble of wires in a holographic quantum circuit that characterize the partially ordered structure of holographic quantum entanglement.
key_findings: Entanglement threads provide a geometric visualization of holographic entanglement structure in MERA
Threads encode the causal flow that distinguishes MERA from other tensor network ansatze
Framework connects to quantum circuit flow conservation — relevant to MERA unitary structure
Partially ordered structure of holographic entanglement given concrete thread-network representation
project_relevance: The 'thread' picture of holographic entanglement is a new geometric framework for understanding what our MERA is doing when it transports holographic excitations. The flow-conserving quantum circuit interpretation directly supports our holographic transport result (HYP-2026-006): the threads are the causal channels through which our transport signal propagates. This could help explain the 0.72% residual in our transport time measurement — threads have discrete structure at finite system size.
